name: Jantt
description: Create interactive Gantt charts with AI : no code required, free forever. Built-in BYOK AI Copilot (10 providers + Ollama), free cloud rooms, working-calendar CPM, 6 views, React/Vue/Svelte/Python/MCP.

capability_evidence.model-routing: with zero sign-up, or sign in free with GitHub for real-time multi-user cloud rooms, shareable links, and unlimited exports.
capability_evidence.mcp-support: - **Official MCP Server (@jantt/mcp):** Connect Claude Desktop, Cursor, Gemini, or custom AI agents directly to 6 deterministic scheduling tools (janttinspectplan, janttaddtask, janttrescheduletask, janttauditschedul
capability_evidence.team-collaboration: a single line of code or JSON unless you want to.

friction.note_en: Turnkey. install via npx one-liner, pip install; needs git clone (build from source), npm install/build; configure OAuth login flow, sign-in required; explicitly no coding required
friction.note_zh: 开箱即用。可通过 npx one-liner、pip install 安装；需要 git clone (build from source)、npm install/build；需配置 OAuth login flow、sign-in required；explicitly no coding required
